recoverableCommitment.interpretation: The wrong founding voice first fails A’s present protection. Adding C restores both stated requirements, but C then loses protection in the changed climate. Recovery is another binding relation, not an extra material payment or an Undo.

limitations: Pareto profiles establish incompatible consequences, not enjoyable decisions.
There are only four towns and three correlated encounters. Observatory has one viable binding group, so it is a teaching/constraint case rather than an expressive-choice claim.

An unrestricted federation that coordinates projects while preserving every local policy would dominate this toy operator. The premise is fusion into one will, not all possible political organization.
